manara.title: A youth activity center in one ecosystem
manara.storyProblem: Communication in a youth activity center flowed through emails, paper, phone calls and parallel chat groups. Activities were assigned by hand, each role had its own channel, and nobody had a full view of a single child.
manara.storySolution: We built a platform that brings parents, kids, instructors and admins into a single ecosystem. Activities are recommended automatically based on the child's age, profile and weak spots. Quizzes and practice plans are generated on the fly, with guardrails to stay pedagogically sound. Real-time messaging across all roles, recurring payments, Google authentication.
manara.storyImpact: Center staff spend less time coordinating and more time on the core job: supporting the kids. Parents finally have a full view of their child's activities and progress. Personalized recommendations lift engagement, and subscriptions are handled without juggling separate tools.

safeaccess.title: Safety rules enforce themselves
safeaccess.storyProblem: PPE rules (hard hat, safety glasses) relied on human checks at the entrance. The predictable outcome: rules get bypassed when the checker looks away, or cost a full-time person posted at the gate.
safeaccess.storySolution: We put in place an access control tied to the equipment worn. Before the badge unlocks the gate, a camera uses computer vision to verify the worker is properly equipped. After three non-compliant attempts by the same worker, the supervisor automatically receives an email and text notification with the employee ID and attempt count.
safeaccess.storyImpact: Rules no longer depend on a human's vigilance. No more full-time gate keeper. Every entry (time, worker, result) is logged: useful for inspections, essential in case of incident. Problem behavior is caught on the third attempt, not after the first accident.

terrasso.title: The business comes out of the owner's phone
terrasso.storyProblem: The entire business (Messenger leads, quotes, reminders, client follow-ups) lived in the owner's head and phone. Every new lead was a mental load, every quote a file sent on the fly, every reminder a sticky note.
terrasso.storySolution: We built a custom desktop tool that centralizes everything: a CRM that sorts prospects (Messenger, email, phone all in one place), a sales funnel, quote management with accounting integration, and automatic follow-ups on communications and reminders. The owner owns the software.
terrasso.storyImpact: The owner is no longer the control tower. Leads no longer get lost in a forgotten Messenger thread. Quotes are tracked to close, accounting reconciles without double entry, and reminders fire at the right time without him having to think about it. His head is free for the field.

plombier.title: 5 seconds of his day per lead, the rest runs itself
plombier.storyProblem: Too many inbound requests, not enough time between jobs to answer them. Every ignored lead was a lost customer, and every evening was spent catching up on admin.
plombier.storySolution: We wired an AI receptionist directly into his WhatsApp. It responds to new contacts in seconds, qualifies the request, confirms availability, then sends the client a text form to collect photos, videos and details of the problem. The plumber gets a complete dossier on his WhatsApp (context, media, confirmed time slot) and just has to reply yes or no. An automatic confirmation or refusal message is sent to the client based on his answer.
plombier.storyImpact: Availability went from "when he has time" to 24/7 without hiring anyone. Leads don't get lost because he's up a ladder. Incoming jobs come pre-qualified with visuals: no more site visits just to understand the problem. His day stays focused on plumbing, not on managing.

faqItems.question: Where should I start to improve my e-commerce performance?

intro.heading: At TDIA, we don't "run ads", we operate a system built for predictable profit.
intro.paragraph1: Media buying isn't a bag of tricks. It's a chain where every link has to hold: diagnosis, budget, creative, funnel, adjustment. Break one piece, and the whole budget pays for it.
intro.paragraph2: Here, in 5 clear steps, is how the Profit-First system turns your ad budget into profit you can forecast.

sections.title: We find the real problem before spending
sections.intro: Before touching a budget, we plug into your stack: Meta, Google, TikTok, Shopify, Klaviyo. Everything lands in one dashboard so we can answer the only question that matters, where is it actually stuck?
sections.subtitle: Three possible diagnoses:
items: VOLUME: demand is there, we just need more fuel.
CONSTRAINT: the message or offer is blocking conversion.
TRACKING: the data lies and hides real performance.
sections.conclusion: This diagnosis stops us from scaling a problem we haven't understood yet.

sections.title: We set what you can pay, and how far you can push
sections.intro: Every product has a recommended CAC, the one that keeps margin, and a max CAC, the one we never cross without losing money. We calculate both thresholds before the first dollar goes out.
sections.subtitle: The budget planner then does three things:
items: Recommend the daily spend that stays in the green.
Block automatic scaling that would break the max CAC.
Adjust the full week based on the CAC we actually observe.
sections.conclusion: You always know how much you can inject, and when it starts to hurt.

sections.title: We prep the creative fuel at the right time
sections.intro: Campaigns die from creative fatigue and seasonality. We calculate upfront the exact number of creatives to ship each week to stay ahead of the algorithm.
sections.subtitle: The calculation factors in:

seo.title: Our methodology : The Profit-First system | TDIA
seo.description: TDIA's Profit-First system in 9 steps: ingestion, diagnostic, allocation & risk, budgets, scored creative, CRO and live optimization. Each step prevents a specific mistake that costs you margin.

overview.headingBefore: The 9-step system that makes every dollar
overview.body: No "scale first, profits later". The Profit-First system is a chain: each step prevents a specific mistake that would cost you margin. We plug in your data, qualify the bottleneck, cap the risk, pace the creative, fix the funnel, and re-read your real cohorts every week.

chain.title: Data ingestion
chain.body: We wire your entire stack, Meta, Google, TikTok, Shopify, Klaviyo, GA4, into a unified feed. Every decision starts from the same truth, with a shared External ID that blocks double-counting.
chain.prevents: reasoning on contradictory dashboards that let every channel lie.

chain.title: VOLUME / CONSTRAINT / TRACKING diagnostic
chain.body: Before any campaign, we qualify the real bottleneck. Volume: demand exists, you need fuel. Constraint: the message or offer is blocking conversion. Tracking: the data lies and hides real performance.
chain.prevents: scaling an offer problem thinking it's a budget problem.

chain.title: Risk management : recommended CAC + max CAC
chain.body: Each product gets two thresholds computed on your margins: the recommended CAC that protects margin, and the max CAC beyond which you lose money. The bounds are set before the first dollar is spent, never after.
chain.prevents: an automation algorithm from pushing you past break-even without asking.

chain.title: Daily & Weekly Budget Planner
chain.body: The planner computes each day the budget that stays under recommended CAC and blocks any drift toward max CAC. At week's end, it rebalances against the actual CAC observed, not the forecast.
chain.prevents: discovering on Friday that a badly-scoped Thursday ate the whole week's margin.

chain.title: Seasonal adjustment
chain.body: Peaks, BFCM, holidays, product launches, shift both demand and competitive pressure. We adjust projected CPMs, daily budget, and creative cadence in advance, so the season doesn't happen to us.
chain.prevents: losing the Black Friday effect because the budget was allocated in January-average mode.

chain.title: Creative Demand : creatives per week
chain.body: The system calculates the exact number of creatives to produce each week to stay ahead of the algorithm, based on the burn rate of your winning formats and per-platform test capacity. The studio gets a quantified brief, not a vague order.
chain.prevents: the creative drought that lets a single video run until fatigue blows CAC up.

chain.title: Creative Scoring OS™
chain.body: Every ad is scored on Hook / Hold / CTR / CR, a cumulative score that says what deserves budget, what needs to iterate, what dies. Budget migrates to the winners every week, no debate.
chain.prevents: "gut feel" or the founder's favorite from deciding where dollars go.

chain.title: CRO Pipeline Engine™
chain.body: Product pages, cart, checkout: every step is mapped. A/B tests are prioritized by revenue impact, not intuition, and shipped weekly with a result measurable in margin, not clicks.
chain.prevents: paid traffic from landing on a page that bleeds, even when the ads are excellent.

chain.title: Live optimization + cohorts
chain.body: Every week, real cohorts, LTV, return rate, net margin per channel, are compared to forecast. Budget migrates toward what actually compounds profit, not what looks bright on Friday night.
chain.prevents: scaling a channel that looks profitable on paper but has a collapsed 60-day LTV.

diagnostic.label: DIAGNOSTIC
diagnostic.body: No budget decision until the bottleneck is qualified. We unify the data, then isolate: volume, constraint, or tracking.

allocation.label: ALLOCATION & RISK
allocation.headingBefore: Budget is spent under a profit
allocation.body: Two thresholds computed on your margins before the first dollar: recommended CAC to protect margin, max CAC to cap the loss.

budgets.label: BUDGETS & SEASONALITY
budgets.body: The planner adjusts daily budget against observed CAC and anticipates seasonal peaks before they hit. Margin is never the last-minute adjustment.

creatif.label: CREATIVE
creatif.headingAfter: on its metrics, not on taste.
creatif.body: Creative count computed weekly, every ad scored on Hook / Hold / CTR / CR. Budget migrates to the winners, no debate.

conversion.label: CONVERSION
conversion.headingBefore: Paid traffic deserves a site that
conversion.body: Hypothesis-driven tests, mapped friction, roadmap prioritized by net impact. The same spend earns more, week after week, without opening another cent.

live.label: LIVE OPTIMIZATION
live.body: LTV, return rate, net margin per channel. Budget migrates toward what actually compounds profit, not what looks bright on Friday night.

modules.title: Cost caps at break-even
modules.body: From day 1, every campaign starts with a cost cap calibrated to your break-even point. A dollar under cap cannot be spent at a loss.

modules.title: Daily predictive adjustments
modules.body: Every morning: a "where will profit be maximized today?" simulation, real CAC trends, 24-48h predicted CAC, expected blended MER. The loss is prevented before it's spent.

modules.title: Audited Budget Change Gate
modules.body: Every budget change passes a gate: justification, capacity, expected impact. No silent raises, no blind cuts, every decision leaves a trace.

modules.title: Unified first-party attribution
modules.body: Unified External ID across Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, TikTok CAPI, Shopify, Klaviyo. CFO-grade attribution, not platform guesses.

modules.title: Creative IQ™ Scoring
modules.body: Every creative scored on Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR and CR, a cumulative score that tells what deserves budget, what needs to iterate, what dies.

modules.title: Hook Rating System™
modules.body: Every hook classified SCALE, ITERATE or KILL based on a composite score (3s watch, 50% completion, CTR, ROAS post-$1k spend). Zero ambiguity on next action.

modules.title: Hook Rate First™
modules.body: Ruthless filtering at the hook level, fixed thresholds: <25% = kill, 25–40% = iterate, >40% = scale. We don't move past a hook that loses 3 of 4 viewers.

modules.title: Cadence Machine™ + Creative Vault™
modules.body: 15–30 concepts per cycle, angle/hook/format bank always ready, replacement before fatigue, never after the drop in performance.

modules.title: Test & Learn Protocol™
modules.body: Every test starts from a hypothesis,"if X, then Y, because Z", and ends with [Tested] [Validated] [Iterate] [Kill]. The knowledge base compounds week after week.

modules.title: Hypothesis Builder™
modules.body: Client picks a page + KPI (CVR, AOV, bounce). The system proposes 3 ready-to-test hypotheses: hypothesis + variation + tracked KPI, launch-ready in < 30 minutes.

modules.title: SmartHeat™
modules.body: Heatmap auto-connected to Shopify / GA: weekly visual summary of ignored zones, ghost clicks and scroll drop-offs. Concrete test suggestions ("CTA too low → raise 200px").

modules.title: FunnelDrop™
modules.body: Dynamic map: landing → PDP → cart → checkout → purchase. Automatic alerts when a step drops (e.g. cart → checkout −28%). CEO decisions in 2 clicks.

generalApplication.title: Your profile isn't in the list?
generalApplication.description: Send us your CV anyway with a few lines on what you'd want to come and ship at TDIA. We reply to every serious application, even outside open roles, the best hires we've made often came in that way.

items.question: How does the hiring process work?
items.answer: We keep the process short and concrete. Step 1: review of your CV and short cover note (48h reply on average). Step 2: a first 30-minute call with the pole lead, we want to understand how you think, not have you recite your CV. Step 3: a technical exercise tied to your role (e.g. an ad account audit for a media buyer, an implementation plan for an operations engineer), you have 3 to 5 days to deliver it, and we pay for your time if the exercise takes more than 2 hours. Step 4: a final interview with the founder to talk alignment, compensation and next steps. From first contact to offer, we aim for under 3 weeks. We always give you written feedback, even if we don't move forward.

items.question: Do you offer internships?
items.answer: Yes, we take two interns per cohort, twice a year (winter and summer sessions). The internship lasts 12 to 16 weeks, is paid, and is structured around a real client mandate, no photocopies or Google Drive tidying. Each intern is paired with a senior mentor who commits at least one hour of coaching per week. At the end of the internship, we run a formal review: roughly one intern in two gets offered a permanent position. Applications are open year-round through this form, just note in your cover that you're aiming for an internship and which session you're targeting.

items.question: What are the benefits and compensation?
items.answer: Competitive salary indexed on Montréal tech market grids (we share the range on the first call, never after). Quarterly bonus indexed on your pole's performance, not on cosmetic KPIs. Group insurance (health, dental, paramedical) covered at 80%. 4 weeks of vacation from year one, plus the holiday week off. Annual training budget of $1,500 per person (conferences, certifications, online courses, your choice). Equipment provided: MacBook Pro or equivalent Windows, monitor, ergonomic chair if you regularly work from home. Team retreat once a year, usually outside Montréal.

items.question: Is remote work truly supported?
items.answer: Yes, 100%. All our roles are open to full remote, regardless of position or pole. You pick where you work from, we don't require any office days. We invest in the tools that make remote viable: Slack for async, Loom for reviews without meetings, Notion for documentation, Google Meet for synchronous check-ins. New hires get a structured remote onboarding with a dedicated senior buddy for the first few weeks. That's where culture transfers, and it prevents you from having to guess how we work.
